description: This file implements service functions for the Standard Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP), including object creation, deletion, and cloning operations used to manage service objects within a container.

methods.name: SLAP_OBJECT SlapScoStdCreateObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name)
methods.description: Creates a new service object within the container using the object name.
parameters: hThisObject: Handle to the current object
obj_name: Name of the object to create

methods.name: SLAP_OBJECT SlapScoStdCreateObject2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name,SLAP_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Creates a new service object with runtime instance context.
parameters: hThisObject: Handle to the current object
obj_name: Name of the object to create

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdDeleteObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_OBJECT hSlapObject)
methods.description: Deletes the specified service object from the container.
parameters: hThisObject: Handle to the current object
hSlapObject: Handle to the object to delete
methods.return: Status code indicating success or failure

methods.name: SLAP_OBJECT SlapScoStdCloneObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Clones the current service object within the container.
parameters: hThisObject: Handle to the current object
